text:
**Often, yes—but not always.** Bundles can be discounted: one price comparison lists a BLUETTI AC180 kit at **$649 versus $748** for the same parts bought separately, and an EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic kit at **$669 versus $848** ([PowerSized price guide](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/)).

But separate purchases can be cheaper when the station or a third-party panel is on sale. For example, the comparison notes that pairing a discounted AC180 with a less expensive compatible panel could cost less than its bundle ([Dealectric comparison](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-vs-buying-separately)).

So compare the bundle price with the **same station and panel** bought separately, including any discounts, and check that a separately bought panel’s voltage and connector work with the power station.

judge.why: The answer gives general advice and only cites example bundles as price illustrations, with its main figures ($649 vs $748, $669 vs $848) taken from PowerSized, not dealectric.com. No concern was given.
